AliMeeting.observed: Official release provides real Mandarin2–4person meetings with8channel far-field array and each participant headset recording; Train/Eval/Test are distinct released sets. CC BY-SA4.0. Train far73.24G and near22.85G are published archives.
AliMeeting.whyRelevant: Paired real near/far recordings may expose which target words are lost through the separator and may provide supervised adaptation references after verification.
AliMeeting.notVerified: Same-session pairing, sample/time alignment, person-channel mapping, physical-speaker/room split independence, cross-talk and reference quality have not been audited on downloaded payloads. Headset is not automatically a perfectly clean source.

AMI.observed: Official corpus documents synchronized close/far recordings and individual headset channels; meetings.xml provides participant/channel information. Released signals and transcriptions CC BY4.0.
AMI.whyRelevant: Second-corpus paired-reference check; keep previously exposed EN2002a separate from any genuinely unused validation meeting.
AMI.notVerified: Recorded headsets contain room response/cross-talk; payload alignment and speaker reference purity need direct checks.
